mapper.select: SELECT ID, CHECK_RESULT_ID, ACKNOWLEDGED_BY, ACKNOWLEDGED_AT, REQUEST_ID, TRACE_ID, RULE_VERSION FROM REVIEW_FINDING_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT WHERE CHECK_RESULT_ID = #{checkResultId}

SELECT A.ID, A.CHECK_RESULT_ID, A.ACKNOWLEDGED_BY, A.ACKNOWLEDGED_AT, A.REQUEST_ID, A.TRACE_ID, A.RULE_VERSION FROM REVIEW_FINDING_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT A JOIN AUDIT_CHECK_RESULT R ON R.ID = A.CHECK_RESULT_ID WHERE R.TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY A.ACKNOWLEDGED_AT, A.ID
